# CG-AUTH-002: Additional scopes required

The same schemes are required, with more scopes.

**Why it matters:** Whether tokens already carry the scope depends on the consumer.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Security](./#auth) |
| Detects | `security.alternativesChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: critical · potentially breaking: high · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {operation} now requires additional scopes: {scopes}.
>
> Tokens without the new scopes will be rejected; existing tokens may already carry them.
>
> **Fix:** Make sure consumers request the new scopes before enforcing them.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: write scope required

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
-     get: {security: [{oauth: [read]}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
+     get: {security: [{oauth: [read, write]}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      oauth: {type: oauth2, flows: {clientCredentials: {tokenUrl: 'https://t', scopes: {read: r, write: w}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, high. GET /x now requires additional scopes: oauth:write.

### Does not fire: scope removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
-     get: {security: [{oauth: [read, write]}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
+     get: {security: [{oauth: [read]}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      oauth: {type: oauth2, flows: {clientCredentials: {tokenUrl: 'https://t', scopes: {read: r, write: w}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml

  ignore:
    - rule: CG-AUTH-002
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
```
